notes.title: Working Toward 2.0
notes.content:
We are currently working toward the release of 2.0. I will probably have one other major update and a few small fixes before 2.0 is ready. 

Currently we are working 1.3 and will have some fixes to do before adding more in. 

1.3 added 


 A new island called Black Star Island
 New enemies including the Dark lord was added in 1.2
 an extended ending
 more music
 new lore and stories that set up and define the Venia universe.



 Listen to how Thistledown lost it's name to the Humans
 the Ages of Man
 Steam City and the Mud-elves


Added achievements and a Steam overlay workaround.

I am new to achievements and Steamworks period. I added a workaround for the Steam overlay that lets you access friends list by pressing Shift+F or achievements Shift+Tab. I had to do this because Path of the Ory is built with a browser based engine and keeps blocking the Steam overlay. Thank you guys for the support! and check out the Maid of Venia Playtest.

Fixed 


 Minimaps on new levels
 Dark Lord achievement
 Spring Fest welcome image size

notes.title: Spring Fest and Version 1.3.0.0
notes.content:
Black Star Island Spring Festival has come again (first annual) to Venia! Version 1.3.0.0 is here!

Explore the Island to find exclusive achievements! During the event, residents of the island have left games for you to find; you can find six claw machines and two other gaming machines and an extra achievement just for showing up.

I am still testing and fixing things so let me know if you find any issues!


 6 Claw Machines
 1 Ball Toss
 1 Wheel of Luck 

To get to Black Star Island go to the dock in Queram and take the small boat at the end of the dock.
The Island is full of amazing music created just for the event!

The festival will end at the end of the month so make sure to join the fun and get the achievements while the party is happening!

notes.title: Jackroid Release
notes.content:
Jackroid Just Released! as a thank you to my Kickstarter supporters and everyone on Steam who has supported me.

I am almost done with the update for Maid of Venia as I am working as quickly as possible so that I can get started on the update for Path of the Ory. 

Path of the Ory update will include:

-Boat animation change at the end as requested in a review
-new art and story at the end of the game.
-2 new levels with more story to help expand Venia
-collision fixes
-new art, artifacts in areas of the game like the Old Keep.
-new animations

Here is a little info on the Maid of Venia update if you are curious:
I have been working nonstop on finishing the update for you guys and will get that out this week/weekend I hope!

Update will have:

30+ new skills
-Fast Travel
-Magma Whale
-Ice Puffer Fish
- Arrow Scourge
-Dwarven Cannon
-Thunderstorm
-Lightningstorm
-Windstorm
-Firestorm
-Druid Drain Dance
-Haunting Ghost Dance
-Monster Mayhem
-Magma Ocean
-Ocean's Call
and more!

Level increase to 30
update vfx on older spells

I am still working all of the skills in and reworking the skill tree.
New art and levels will include:
-a new blacksmith in Thistledown
-a festival, Namesake Day, where the many races that live in Thistledown celebrate the reclaiming of the land from humans and renaming of the town that has always been to them Thistledown.
-2 races more defined and more characters, story and quest to show off the new races!

notes.title: New End Animations
notes.content:
Added new end animations to help convey the story. The end now has pixel art as well as anime art. 
 
Next update I am adding more places to explore and more story sections to expand our knowledge of Venia

- We will go into the ages of Venia, and how the Human expanses define them. Path of the Ory is set after the Third Human expanse and just before the third Great Regression. 

-We will also go into Venor, a great Titan (aka Mud-Dwarf) and one of the first of his kind to live above ground and Hunt and eat like the rest of Venia's creatures. 

-I Can also add to the end battle if people are interested. 
You can't defeat the dark lord, he will appear in Maid of Venia, but I could make it so that you battle him after defeating the resurrected enemies. 

Let me know what you guys think, stuff you like or don't or anything you want me to try and add.
Thank you so much for your support! 

I have a free thank you game coming next month! It's called Jackroid, it was developed for my nephew's 11th birthday six years ago and is the first game I made after starting my game dev journey. I decided not to sell it or bundle it or anything but instead, because the support has been so wonderful on here, I decided to put it up for free. The store page is approved and the game will be up next month if the build is approved.

notes.title: Intro Art
notes.content:
Added intro art and animations to help show Kayla as she grows with the Ory. If you start a new game, to see the new intro, you will lose your save. If you have already started a save, I would suggest beating the game and then going through the intro. If you do multiple playthroughs, remember to master new weapons and skills. Blood magic is fun and the Flute is surprisingly effective. 

Thank you guys so much for the support! It really does mean the world to me and my family!

let me know if you find any issues or have any questions or concerns, I am always here and ready to help!

Don't forget to check out the playtest for 
Maid of Venia 

Path of the Ory is a prequal to Maid of Venia and explains how monsters came to Venia!
